title: Symmetric localization on the published K-flat tensor
statement: For a site small relative to the module universe and a commutative ring sheaf R, the published unbounded K-flat tensor bifunctor on D(Mod(R)) admits a symmetric monoidal structure and a lax braided cochain localization Q. Its unit comparison is invertible; μQ(P,Q) is invertible whenever the second complex is K-flat. The uncurried tensor bifunctor is exactly the published bifunctor, on objects and maps. Dependencies: [lem-sfb-ring-isomorphism-tensor-transport], [lem-sf-cochain-tensor-model-rigidity], [lem-pur-u2-prescribed-tensor].

lean.statement:
theorem ringIso_published_tensor :
    ∃ m : MonoidalCategory (DerivedCategory (scalarModules J R)), letI := m
    ∃ b : SymmetricCategory (DerivedCategory (scalarModules J R)), letI := b
    ∃ q : (DerivedCategory.Q (C := scalarModules J R)).LaxBraided, letI := q
      IsIso (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (DerivedCategory.Q (C := scalarModules J R))) ∧
      (∀ P Q : CochainComplex (scalarModules J R) ℤ,
        Q.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
          IsIso (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q P Q)) ∧
      Functor.uncurry.obj (curriedTensor (DerivedCategory (scalarModules J R))) =
        siteDerivedTensorIndependentCoefficients J R
